ops.new:
-- rc3 update watch (the owner: "the game and the data will keep updating,
-- always watch for it"): every lookup that MISSES (a spell name, a tooltip
-- line, a zone the data has no Persian for) is remembered once, with a hit
-- counter, in the saved variables (capped). The status page shows the list in
-- a copy box; the next data update translates exactly what the live game
-- shows. The addon never sends it anywhere.
F.MISS_CAP = 400
function F:Miss(kind, key, sample, ctx)
    local db = F.db
    if not db or type(key) ~= "string" or key == "" then
        return
    end
    if type(db.miss) ~= "table" then
        db.miss, db.missN = {}, 0
    end
    local id = tostring(kind) .. ":" .. key
    local e = db.miss[id]
    if e then
        e.n = (tonumber(e.n) or 1) + 1
        return
    end
    if (tonumber(db.missN) or 0) >= F.MISS_CAP then
        return
    end
    db.miss[id] = { k = tostring(kind), t = string.sub(tostring(sample or key), 1, 300),
        c = ctx and string.sub(tostring(ctx), 1, 80) or nil, n = 1, b = F.clientBuild or 0 }
    db.missN = (tonumber(db.missN) or 0) + 1
    F:Fire("miss")
end

function F:ClearMiss()
    if F.db then
        F.db.miss, F.db.missN = {}, 0
        F:Fire("miss")
    end
end

    -- rc3 update watch: the misses as ONE line (a single-line box never grows
    -- over the rows below; Ctrl+C copies all of it). Entries: kind :: text ::
    -- spell/context :: xCount, most seen first
    if health.missList then
        local list = {}
        for _, e in pairs(F.db and type(F.db.miss) == "table" and F.db.miss or {}) do
            list[#list + 1] = e
        end
        table.sort(list, function(a, b)
            local x, y = tonumber(a.n) or 0, tonumber(b.n) or 0
            if x ~= y then
                return x > y
            end
            return tostring(a.t) < tostring(b.t)
        end)
        local out = { string.format("WoWFA %s b%s misses=%d", tostring(F.VERSION), tostring(F.clientBuildText or "?"), #list) }
        for i = 1, #list do
            local e = list[i]
            local t = string.gsub(tostring(e.t or ""), "|", "!")
            t = string.gsub(t, "[\r\n]+", " / ")
            out[#out + 1] = string.format("%s :: %s :: %s :: x%d", tostring(e.k), t, tostring(e.c or ""), tonumber(e.n) or 1)
        end
        health.missList:SetFixed(table.concat(out, " ;; "))
        health.missHead:SetFa(string.format(L.h_miss_n, #list), PW - 30)
    end
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ miss recorder (rc3 update watch)
local okMiss, errMiss = pcall(function()
    F:ClearMiss()
    check("miss log starts empty", F.db.missN == 0, F.db.missN)
    F:Miss("tpl", "a totally unknown line #", "A totally unknown line 5.", "Test Spell")
    F:Miss("tpl", "a totally unknown line #", "A totally unknown line 6.", "Test Spell")
    local e = F.db.miss["tpl:a totally unknown line #"]
    check("miss kept once, counted twice", e ~= nil and e.n == 2 and F.db.missN == 1, e and e.n)
    F.OpenPanel("health")
    RunTimers()
    local PF = F.PanelFrame()
    local box = PF and PF.health and PF.health.missList
    local txt = box and box:GetText() or ""
    check("status page lists the misses", txt:find("misses=1", 1, true) ~= nil and txt:find("A totally unknown line 5.", 1, true) ~= nil, txt)
    F:Miss("zone", "some new zone", "Some New Zone|x")
    txt = box and box:GetText() or ""
    check("a new miss shows while the panel is open (pipe escaped)", txt:find("misses=2", 1, true) ~= nil and txt:find("Some New Zone!x", 1, true) ~= nil, txt)
    for i = 1, F.MISS_CAP + 20 do
        F:Miss("zone", "zone " .. i, "Zone " .. i)
    end
    check("miss log is capped", F.db.missN == F.MISS_CAP, F.db.missN)
    Click(PF.missClear)
    check("clear empties the miss log", F.db.missN == 0 and next(F.db.miss) == nil, F.db.missN)
    check("box shows the empty log", (box:GetText() or ""):find("misses=0", 1, true) ~= nil, box:GetText())
    F.TogglePanel()
end)
check("miss recorder tests ran", okMiss, errMiss)
